emergencyKit.intro: Uma ulahlekelwa yile divayisi, lo khiye uyindlela ongena ngayo kwentsha. Ngeke sikwazi ukukubuyisela wona, ngakho wubhale phansi noma uwulondoloze esiphathini samaphasiwedi.
emergencyKit.title: Londoloza ukhiye wokubuyisela
emergencyKit.warning: Noma ubani onalo khiye angangena njengawe.

enrollment.chooserIntro: Le divayisi ayikabi nabo okhiye bakho. Khetha ukuthi uzobafaka kanjani kuyo.
enrollment.pollingIntro: Kudivayisi esivele ingenile, vula okuthi Mina → Ukuphepha bese uvuma isicelo ngekhodi engezansi.
enrollment.recoveryIntro: Namathisela ukhiye wokubuyisela owawulondoloza ngesikhathi uqala ukubhalisa. Ubukeka njengochungechunge olude lwezinhlamvu nezinombolo.
enrollment.waitFailed: Ayikwazanga ukuhlola imvume. Hlola uxhumano lwakho, bese uzama futhi.

changeEmail.enterCodeIntro: Faka ikhodi esiyithumele ku-{{email}}, nalena esiyithumele ekhelini olishiyayo. Ushintsho kufanele luvunywe kusuka ekhelini elingumnikazi we-akhawunti.

changeEmail.title: Shintsha i-imeyili

deleteAccount.consequences: Lokhu kususa unomphela i-akhawunti yakho ye-Pollis. Uyasuswa kuwo wonke amaqembu nezingxoxo, amadivayisi akho ayasuswa ekubhalisweni, futhi idatha yakho ebethelwe kule divayisi iyasulwa. Amanye amalungu agcina amakhophi awo emilayezo yangaphambilini, kodwa akukho okuthunyelwe ngemuva kokususwa okungake kufundwe ngokhiye bakho.
deleteAccount.failed: Ayikwazanga ukususa i-akhawunti. Akukho okushintshile. Zama futhi.
deleteAccount.irreversible: Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa. Asikho isikhathi sokubuyela emuva futhi akukho ukubuyisa.
deleteAccount.title: Susa i-akhawunti

scanDevice.scanIntro: Kudivayisi oyingenisayo, khetha okuthi Ngena ngenye idivayisi. Khomba ikhamera kukhodi ekhombisayo.
scanDevice.codeIntro: Bhala noma unamathisele ikhodi ekhonjiswe ngaphansi kwe-QR kwenye idivayisi.
scanDevice.warning: Skena kuphela ikhodi esedivayisini ephambi kwakho oyingenisa wena uqobo. Izokwazi ukufunda imilayezo yakho.
scanDevice.wrongDirection: Leyo khodi ingenisa lolu hlobo lwedivayisi ngenye indlela. Kudivayisi entsha, khetha okuthi Ngena ngenye idivayisi ukuze ubone efanele.
scanDevice.confirmBody: Faka i-PIN yakho ukuze ungenise idivayisi ekhombisa ikhodi.
scanDevice.linkingBody: Gcina i-Pollis ivuliwe kuwo womabili amadivayisi isikhashana.
scanDevice.notFinished: Enye idivayisi ayiqedanga ukungena. Khombisa ikhodi entsha kuyo bese uskena futhi.

biometric.offerBody: Sebenzisa {{method}} esikhundleni sokubhala i-PIN yakho uma uvula i-Pollis. I-PIN yakho isasebenza, futhi uzoyidinga ukuze uxhume idivayisi, uvume ukukopishwa komlando noma ushintshe i-PIN yakho.
biometric.failed: Ayikwazanga ukuvula ukuvula nge-biometric. Zama futhi ku-Ukuphepha.
biometric.switchSub: Esikhundleni sokubhala i-PIN yakho ukuze uvule. Ukuxhuma idivayisi nokushintsha i-PIN yakho kusayidinga.
biometric.unavailableSub: {{method}} akusethiwe kule divayisi. Vala lokhu, noma ukusethe kuzilungiselelo zesistimu.
biometric.confirmBody: Faka i-PIN yakho ukuze uvule ukuvula usebenzisa {{method}}.
biometric.changed: Izilungiselelo zakho ze-{{method}} zishintshile. Faka i-PIN yakho; ukuvula nge-biometric kuzobuya kuvuleke ngemuva kwalokho.

permissions.camera: I-Pollis idinga ikhamera yakho ukuze iskene amakhodi e-QR okungena avela kwamanye amadivayisi akho futhi ithathe isithombe sakho sephrofayela.
permissions.photoLibrary: I-Pollis idinga ukufinyelela emtapweni wakho wezithombe ukuze ukwazi ukunamathisela izithombe emilayezweni, ukhethe isithombe sakho sephrofayela futhi ulayishe ama-emoji eqembu enziwe ngokwezifiso.
permissions.photoLibraryAdd: I-Pollis ilondoloza izithombe namavidiyo owakhethayo emtapweni wakho wezithombe.
permissions.faceId: I-Pollis isebenzisa i-Face ID ukuvula uhlelo lokusebenza esikhundleni se-PIN yakho, kuphela uma ukuvulile.

bots.title: Ama-bot
bots.intro: I-bot yilungu le-{{group}} elisebenza kumshini olawulwa ngumphathi. Ifunda yonke imilayezo eyamukelayo lapha, futhi ithumela ngegama layo.
bots.adminsOnly: Abaphathi beqembu leli kuphela abangengeza noma baphathe ama-bot.
bots.capReached: Leli qembu lifinyelele umkhawulo walo wama-bot angu-{{cap}}. Susa elilodwa ukuze ungeze elinye.
bots.machineNote: I-bot isebenza kumshini owulawulayo. Ingafunda konke ekwamukelayo ku-{{group}}, ngakho yiqhube kuphela endaweni oyethembayo.
bots.nameHint: Amalungu abona leli gama emilayezweni ye-bot.
bots.codeHint: Thayipha ikhodi yezinhlamvu eziyisishiyagalombili ephrintwe umyalo. Yifunde esikrinini salowo mshini; ayilokothi igcwaliswe esikhundleni sakho.

errors.codeMismatch: Leyo khodi ayifani. Yihlole emshinini we-bot bese uyithayipha futhi.
errors.capReached: Leli qembu selinama-bot amaningi ngangokusemandleni alo. Susa elilodwa kuqala.
errors.expired: Leso sicelo sokubhangqa siphelelwe yisikhathi. Qhuba umyalo futhi ukuze uthole ikhodi entsha.

bots.unrecoverable: Umshini ngamunye lapha uqhuba le bot. Uma yonke imishini ilahleka, i-bot ayikwazi ukubuyiswa: yisuse bese wenza entsha.
bots.noHosts: Le bot ayisenamshini, ngakho ayikwazi ukusebenza futhi. Yisuse bese wenza entsha.
bots.lastHostWarning: Lona ngumshini wokugcina we-bot. Ukuwuhoxisa kusho ukuthi i-bot ayisoze yasebenza futhi; kuzodingeka uyisuse bese wenza entsha.
bots.deleteHint: Isusa i-bot ku-{{group}} futhi imise yonke imishini yayo. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
